text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru simply cannot believe 
that she lost the Kinko Sho.

So utterly devastated that she felt 
abandoned by God and luck, she shed tears 
and muttered that she wished she would 
wake up from this nightmare.

Her tears showed no sign of stopping, even 
when told that the Takarazuka Kinen was 
her next goal.
